title: Software Test Engineer - Manual & Automation Testing
description:

Develop, execute, and maintain automated test scripts. Identify, document, track, and report bugs using JIRA or similar tools. Perform API testing using Postman or equivalent tools. Validate application functionality across different browsers and devices. Collaborate with developers and project teams to resolve defects. Participate in Agile ceremonies and testing activities throughout the SDLC. Ensure quality standards are maintained before product releases. 
 Required Skills & Qualifications: 3-4 years of experience in Software Testing. Strong hands-on experience in Manual and Automation Testing. Good knowledge of Selenium WebDriver and automation frameworks. Working knowledge of Java, Python, or JavaScript. Experience with API testing using Postman. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
